blocks.text: Pohjanmaan Metalli Oy is a Seinäjoki sheet-metal and subcontract manufacturer of about 65 people. Its RFQs arrive by email as PDFs and CAD files, roughly 35 a week, and the sales engineer Kaisa wrote each quote by hand in Excel. Her own two-week log put the average at 52 minutes per quote.
The first real obstacle was data, not AI. Material names were written inconsistently (S355, S355J2, 'rakenneteräs'), so the team built a 60-row mapping table with Kaisa before anything else worked.

The shipped tool is deliberately narrow. It extracts the quantity, material, finish and delivery date from the RFQ and pre-fills the existing Excel template, with the last similar price pulled from history. It does not estimate cost from CAD geometry, and Kaisa still sets every price. In a two-week pilot covering 29 quotes, the average fell to about 31 minutes and median turnaround fell from 4.5 to 2.5 working days.

Kaisa checks every pre-filled field, which caught four wrong quantities during the pilot. The team has not yet measured win rates or whether evening work decreased; both are open questions, and the next step is adding a win/loss column to measure them.

sourceRecord.text:
Client: Pohjanmaan Metalli Oy
Project owner: Jussi Kärkkäinen
SME ~65 hlö, Seinäjoki. Owner-ish: Risto. Sales eng: Kaisa (bottleneck)
- RFQs come as PDF + DXF/STEP via email, ~35/wk. Kaisa makes tarjous in Excel by hand
- time per quote: avg 52 min (Kaisa self-log 2 wks, 41 quotes), simple repeat parts ~30 min, complex 90+
- quote turnaround (RFQ->sent): median 4.5 working days. Risto: 'we lose jobs for being slow' - plausible but no win/loss data yet
- smallest build: extract RFQ fields from email/PDF (qty, material, finish, delivery date) -> prefill existing Excel quote template + pull last similar price from history
- NOT doing geometry/cost estimation from CAD (too big for 1 mo). Kaisa still sets price
- wk1 mess: material names inconsistent (S355 / S355J2 / 'rakenneteräs'). built mapping table 60 rows w/ Kaisa
- wk2: extraction correct on all key fields 78% of 50 old RFQs; 15 more had 1 field wrong; 5 total fails (scanned fax-looking PDFs lol)
- pilot wk3-4, 29 quotes: avg 31 min (-40%). turnaround median 4.5 -> 2.5 d
- Kaisa checks every prefilled field, found 4 wrong qty in 29 (14% quotes had >=1 error, caught before sending)
- adoption: Kaisa yes. second estimator (Veikko) retires in Mar, wants to learn it anyway, ok
- unmeasured: Kaisa says less 'iltatyö'. nice but anecdotal
- next: win/loss column in Excel so we can actually measure
